## Control

Develop and update [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] an inventory of organizational systems.

## Discussion

[OMB A-130](https://www.whitehouse.gov/sites/whitehouse.gov/files/omb/circulars/A130/a130revised.pdf) provides guidance on developing systems inventories and associated reporting requirements. System inventory refers to an organization-wide inventory of systems, not system components as described in CM-8.
